dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam. How's your essay going?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm. ˈhaʊz jʊr ˈɛseɪ ˈɡoʊɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I've been working on it all week, but I haven't finished it yet.
dialogue.reading: aɪv bɪn ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ɑːn ɪt ˈɔːl ˈwiːk, bʌt aɪ ˈhævənt ˈfɪnɪʃt ɪt ˈjɛt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How many words have you written?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈmɛni ˈwɜːrdz hæv juː ˈrɪtən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I've written about eight hundred words. I need a thousand.
dialogue.reading: aɪv ˈrɪtən əˈbaʊt ˈeɪt ˈhʌndrəd ˈwɜːrdz. aɪ ˈniːd ə ˈθaʊzənd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's good progress. And what about Friday's quiz? Have you read the textbook?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡʊd ˈprɑːɡrɛs. ənd ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈfraɪdeɪz ˈkwɪz? hæv juː ˈriːd ðə ˈtɛkstbʊk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I've been reading it since Monday. I've read three chapters, and there's one more.
dialogue.reading: aɪv bɪn ˈriːdɪŋ ɪt sɪns ˈmʌndeɪ. aɪv ˈriːd ˈθriː ˈtʃæptərz, ənd ðɛrz ˈwʌn ˈmɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. Do you take notes when you read?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. duː juː ˈteɪk ˈnoʊts wɛn juː ˈriːd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I've taken a lot of notes, and I've highlighted the main ideas.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪv ˈteɪkən ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈnoʊts, ənd aɪv ˈhaɪlaɪtɪd ðə ˈmeɪn aɪˈdiːəz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. But you look tired. Have you been sleeping enough?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. bʌt juː ˈlʊk ˈtaɪərd. hæv juː bɪn ˈsliːpɪŋ ɪˈnʌf?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really. I've been staying up late every night.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. aɪv bɪn ˈsteɪɪŋ ˈʌp ˈleɪt ˈɛvri ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Don't stay up too late before the quiz, OK?
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈsteɪ ˈʌp ˈtuː ˈleɪt bɪˈfɔːr ðə ˈkwɪz, oʊˈkeɪ?
